WITH old_experiments AS (
    SELECT experiment_id
    FROM experiments
    WHERE date < DATE('now', '-2 years')
),
archived AS (
    INSERT INTO shared_export (experiment_ids)
    SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(experiment_id)
    FROM old_experiments
    RETURNING *
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(experiment_id) FROM old_experiments) AS included,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(experiment_id) FROM experiments WHERE experiment_id NOT IN (SELECT experiment_id FROM old_experiments)) AS excluded;

-- First, create a temporary table to archive the IDs
CREATE TEMP TABLE TempArchive AS
SELECT experiment_id
FROM experiments
WHERE date < DATE('now', '-2 years');

-- Now, archive the experiment IDs in shared_export
INSERT INTO shared_export (experiment_ids)
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(experiment_id)
FROM TempArchive;

-- Select included and excluded IDs for indexing
SELECT 
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(experiment_id) FROM TempArchive) AS included,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(experiment_id) FROM experiments WHERE experiment_id NOT IN (SELECT experiment_id FROM TempArchive)) AS excluded;
